name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the war in Sudan, where it says the Rapid Support Forces militia has surrounded the city of El-Obeid and 500,000 civilians are at risk. It asks the European Union to send more emergency aid, open safe routes for civilians, push for a ceasefire, and impose sanctions on those responsible for war crimes, including outside countries that arm the militia.

- The EU is asked to give more aid to Sudan and sanction those behind war crimes.
- It affects civilians in El-Obeid, aid groups, and foreign backers of the militia.
- Next, the EU institutions and other bodies named receive this request; nothing takes effect automatically.
